entities.summary: Founded in 1660, the oldest national scientific society in the world. Its motto "Nullius in verba" ("Take nobody's word for it") established the principle of empirical verification. Newton, Darwin, Hawking, and over 1,600 FRS fellows shaped global science. Its Philosophical Transactions (1665) is the world's oldest scientific journal.
